dataset.name: Numenta Anomaly Benchmark (NAB), labelled real-data folders
dataset.citation: Ahmad, S., Lavin, A., Purdy, S., Agha, Z. (2017). Unsupervised real-time anomaly detection for streaming data. Neurocomputing 262, 134-147.

code.note: commit is the commit the run was made at; files_sha256 pins the exact code
code.commit_note: commit refers to the private development archive and is not resolvable in the public repository sparkainlp-x/oes512q-latch; files_sha256 pins the exact code that produced these results

protocol.reference: median of trailing baseline samples before each block (causal)
protocol.residual_scale: 1.4826*MAD of raw residuals on warm-up blocks; if MAD = 0, 1.2533*mean absolute deviation from the median
protocol.trim_rule: drop warm-up blocks with max|r| > Q3 + 3.0*IQR
protocol.aggregates_exclude: series with zero positive test blocks

evidence.calibrated: REPORTED (warm-up q0.99 threshold per detector and series; labels unused)
evidence.trimmed: REPORTED (warm-up q0.99 after label-free Tukey trimming; labels unused)
evidence.oracle: REPORTED, TUNED on test labels (best-F1 per series; optimistic upper bound)
evidence.tau_sweep: REPORTED, TUNED on test labels (single tau for all series)
evidence.block_16_64: REPORTED sensitivity analysis; not the OES-32 contract (block = 32)
evidence.reference: REPORTED trivial references: flag-all F1; random-ranking AP = prevalence

speed.note: best of 3 per series, summed over evaluated block-32 series; machine-dependent

nab_score.evidence: REPORTED (NAB official scorer on a sub-corpus; see note)
nab_score.note: Sub-corpus = the series evaluated at block 32. Our detectors: binary detections at warm-up-calibrated thresholds, scored at threshold 0.5 without NAB optimisation. Published detectors: official NAB result files and thresholds (optimised by NAB on the full corpus with labels). Normalised against the null detector on the same sub-corpus. Not comparable to the official NAB scoreboard.
